programmes.d: After a single mother sees her son possessed by a demon, a scientist tries to free the boy. Haunted by his own past, he uses a risky method to enter the child’s mind, where he faces a deadly spirit and his own inner demons.
Two FBI agents and a Florida State officer team up to investigate a string of unsolved murder cases.
Micki's college roommate wants her to be bridesmaid at her wedding. However, the woman's fiance, a ventriloquist, appears to be going insane.
A demented beekeeper, McCabe, uses a cursed antique beehive in a complicated scheme. First, he turns loose the bees in the beehive, which kill someone and make a blood-honey.

When serial killer Charles Lee Ray is mortally wounded in a police shoot-out, he uses a voodoo spell to transfer his soul into Chucky, a Good Guys doll. Young Andy receives the doll as a birthday gift, and Chucky soon resumes his killing spree.

Will hatches a cunning plot to slay Francis Dolarhyde, using Hannibal Lecter in his ploy. Bedelia voices concern about the perilous plan as Will continues his game with Hannibal, though Will may have to face his darkest fears.
